_note: SIMPLIFIED FOR EDUCATION — rates are game-tuned; mitigations teach real operations.

events.name: Solar storm
events.description: Charged particles degrade panels and threaten electronics.
events.mitigation: Enable SHLD (safe mode) to ride it out.

events.name: Debris conjunction
events.mitigation: FIRE avoidance burn (costs propellant) or accept risk.
events.mitigationAr: مناورة تفادٍ بـ FIRE (تكلف وقودا) أو اقبل الخطر.

events.name: Battery degradation
events.description: Cells lose capacity after deep cycling.
events.descriptionAr: الخلايا تفقد سعتها بعد دورات عميقة.
events.mitigation: Larger battery margin in design; reduce loads.
events.mitigationAr: هامش بطارية أكبر في التصميم; قلل الأحمال.

events.name: Comms loss
events.mitigation: COM retry; higher-gain antenna in design.
events.mitigationAr: أعد المحاولة بـ COM; هوائي أعلى كسبا في التصميم.

events.name: Fuel leak
events.mitigation: None in flight — design reliable propulsion.
events.mitigationAr: لا حل أثناء الطيران — صمم دفعا موثوقا.

events.name: Overheating
events.mitigation: SHLD safe mode reduces payload draw and heat.
